title: Every source given must be needed
statement: When the skill is combining sources or formats, every source given must be needed to reach the answer.
detail: Integration items carried pictures their own explanations never used, and synthesis items came down to matching a single note. The ELA rubric now fails alignment for any stimulus that isn't load-bearing and requires integration to demand combining at least two formats (`icloud-work/inceptbench-main/src/inceptbench/prompts/question/ela_evaluation.txt`); a deterministic check fails an integration item whose explanation never refers to its image (`icloud-work/inceptbench-main/src/inceptbench/evaluators/question.py`); and the reading and writing rubric fails the alignment of a synthesis item that keyword matching against one note can answer (`icloud-work/inceptbench-main/src/inceptbench/prompts/question/sat_rw_evaluation.txt`). It carries the rule that a question must need its text over to items with several sources.

evidence.quote: Integration must demand combining at least two formats to reach the answer.
if the item carries an image_url but the answer_explanation never references any visual element, the image is decorative and the item fails the integration demand.
If the aim is so narrow that only one note is relevant and the student can identify the correct answer by simple keyword matching, the item reduces synthesis to a matching exercise.
the stem itself states the direction (urchin→otter), so a student can answer correctly from the stem's own wording without ever consulting the diagram or applying the rule.
the rule now lives only in the passage/key text, never on the map.
